visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation begins with a white cartoon character sitting on a large yellow beanbag cushion against a stark white background. The character holds a small black rectangular smartphone and taps on the screen with a skeptical, slightly worried facial expression. (2) The scene cuts to a black screen with white text appearing in the center to mark a temporal transition. (3) The character is now inside a room with red walls, huddled and visibly shivering with small blue droplets on its face. To the right, a square window shows jagged blue and white lines representing a heavy rainstorm outside. (4) An exterior view reveals a giant, muscular greyish-blue monster with glowing white eyes shaking a small red three-story building. The background is dark blue with radial motion lines, and heavy rain is represented by fast-moving white streaks across the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks in a cynical, unimpressed tone, questioning the name of a typhoon. The speech rate is quick, and the pitch varies to convey a provocative attitude. The audio environment is a very clean studio recording with zero background music. (2) A brief moment of strategic silence occurs during the screen transition. (3) Rhythmic, percussive impact sounds begin, simulating heavy objects shaking. The character's voice changes to a shivering, panicked quality with high vocal tension and short, breathy gasps. (4) High-arousal shouting begins as the voice adopts a deep, aggressive persona. Loud 'thudding' impact sound effects occur in sync with the visual shaking of the building. The speaker uses a mix of Mandarin and Hokkien to mock the character in a high-intensity, confrontational manner.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A humorous animated short that parodies someone underestimating the power of a typhoon based on its weak-sounding name, only to be terrified when it actually arrives half a day later.
